latin: Calorem ab aqua ad aerem transfer.
japanese: 熱を水から空気へ移せ。
key_morphology: calorem=acc.sg; ab aqua=ab+abl.sg; ad aerem=ad+acc.sg; transfer=imperative
notes: Heat is not a conserved quantity kind; elaborate to Energy/Thermal.

latin: Canalem energiae a fonte ad globum aperi.
japanese: エネルギーのチャネルを源から球へ開け。
key_morphology: canalem=acc.sg; energiae=gen.sg; a fonte=a+abl.sg; ad globum=ad+acc.sg; aperi=imperative
notes: energia is technical/Neo-Latin.

latin: Quantitatem motus a terra ad lapidem transfer.
japanese: 運動量を地面から石へ移せ。
key_morphology: quantitatem=acc.sg; motus=gen.sg; a terra=a+abl.sg; ad lapidem=ad+acc.sg; transfer=imperative
notes: quantitas motus is preferred to equating impetus directly with modern momentum.

latin: Moleculas aquae in structuram crystallinam compone.
japanese: 水の分子を結晶構造へ組み替えよ。
key_morphology: moleculas=acc.pl; aquae=gen.sg; in structuram crystallinam=in+acc.sg; compone=imperative
notes: molecula is scientific/Neo-Latin terminology.

japanese: 球の球形を維持せよ。
notes: Earlier example; persistent constraints are preferably expressed with prescriptive subjunctive in strict Magical Latin.

japanese: 球は円内に留まるものとする。
notes: Canonical subjunctive constraint example.

japanese: 球を円内へ動かせ。
notes: MOVE is a high-level library operation, not an MKI primitive.

japanese: 外部物体は境界を越えてはならない。
notes: Persistent prohibition / barrier predicate.

japanese: この石を指定せよ。
notes: Produces an early-bound Ref when stored.

japanese: この石の温度を観測せよ。
notes: Temperature is observable but not transferable as a conserved quantity.

japanese: この球を私のために確保せよ。
notes: Maps to a lease/reservation abstraction rather than a physical MKI operation.

japanese: エネルギーの接続を確立せよ。
notes: nexum is used as a technical connection term.

japanese: 変更をコミットせよ。
notes: Technical semantic extension of committo.

japanese: この接続を解け。
notes: Control-plane revocation example.

latin: Nemo praeter dominum hunc nexum mutet.
japanese: 所有者以外はこの接続を変更してはならない。
key_morphology: nemo=nom.sg; praeter dominum=praeter+acc.sg; hunc nexum=acc.sg; mutet=pres.subj.3sg
notes: Persistent authorization rule.

japanese: 接続の終端を起点となる術者へ向け直せ。
notes: nexus is formally ambiguous in isolation; frame/context must resolve it.

japanese: 水を結晶構造へ組み替えよ。
notes: Requires separate energy balance handling.

latin: Si lapis intra circulum est, nexum aperi.
japanese: 石が円内にあるなら、接続を開け。
key_morphology: si=conditional; lapis=nom.sg; intra circulum=intra+acc.sg; est=indicative; nexum=acc.sg; aperi=imperative
notes: Example that conditions need not use subjunctive uniformly.

latin: Si lapis intra circulum est, nexum aperi; sin autem, siste.
japanese: 石が円内にあるなら接続を開け。そうでなければ停止せよ。
notes: Used to illustrate else branching.

japanese: この操作を三回実行せよ。
key_morphology: hanc operationem=acc.sg; ter=adverb; exsequere=imperative of deponent exsequor
notes: Finite repetition example.

japanese: 水の温度を観測せよ。
notes: Compact observation example.

latin: Si temperatura aquae maior quam terminus est, calorem ab aqua ad receptaculum transfer.
japanese: 水の温度が基準値より高ければ、熱を水から受容器へ移せ。
key_morphology: temperatura=nom.sg; aquae=gen.sg; maior=comparative nom.sg.fem; quam terminus=comparative phrase; calorem=acc.sg
notes: terminus/receptaculum are technical choices subject to future Latin editorial review.

japanese: この権限をスヴェータに委譲せよ。
notes: Dative maps naturally to Recipient.

japanese: この石を追跡せよ。
key_morphology: hunc lapidem=acc.sg; sequere=imperative of deponent sequor
notes: Tracking is not itself CONSTRAIN.

japanese: 私の前にある石を打て。
notes: Intended as late-bound spatial description.

latin: Hunc lapidem designa. Eundem postea feri.
japanese: この石を指定せよ。後でまさに同じものを打て。
key_morphology: hunc lapidem=acc.sg; designa=imperative; eundem=acc.sg.masc of idem; postea=adverb; feri=imperative
notes: eundem expresses reuse of the same identity-bound target.

latin: Hoc corpus in duas partes divide.
japanese: この物体を二つの部分に分割せよ。
key_morphology: hoc corpus=acc.sg.neut; in duas partes=in+acc.pl; divide=imperative
notes: Default Object identity policy terminates the old identity on one-to-many split.

japanese: 3秒後に接続を開け。
key_morphology: post=preposition; tria secunda=technical time expression; nexum=acc.sg; aperi=imperative
notes: Time-unit wording is explicitly technical Latin.

latin: Cum corpus limen attingat, nexum momentum aperi.
japanese: 物体が境界に触れたとき、運動量の接続を開け。
notes: Deprecated because nexum momentum is not the preferred genitive technical phrase.

latin: Cum corpus limen attingat, nexum quantitatis motus aperi.
japanese: 物体が境界に触れたとき、運動量の接続を開け。
key_morphology: cum clause; corpus=nom.sg; limen=acc.sg; attingat=subj.3sg; quantitatis motus=genitive phrase
notes: Preferred correction of LAT-029.

latin: Cum hostis limen transeat, globum emitte.
japanese: 敵が境界を越えたとき、球を放て。
notes: Canonical event example.

japanese: 一度だけ、〜するとき……
notes: Fragment used to motivate one-shot event subscription.

japanese: 〜するたびに……
notes: Fragment used to motivate repeated event subscription.

latin: Calorem quinque milium unitatum ab aqua ad aerem transfer.
japanese: 5000単位の熱を水から空気へ移せ。
key_morphology: calorem=acc.sg; quinque milium unitatum=quantity phrase; ab aqua; ad aerem; transfer=imperative
notes: Illustrative only; strict language should use a defined unit syntax rather than generic unitatum.
